meta.name: agentkit-multimedia-shopping
meta.description: 基于ByteDance agentkit-samples多媒体用例的小省导购员数字人带货视频生成技能，整合多模态内容生成能力（图像、视频、音频），支持AI绘画、语音合成、视频生成，与小省导购员人设融合，9:16竖屏适配，直接对接带货视频生成流程

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成带货视频，融合图像、语音和动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成带货视频并整合多模态内容
copy.tagline_en: Generate shopping videos with images, voice, and animation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create product promotion videos with multimodal content

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按「图像→音频→视频」的顺序，产出小省导购员的带货视频素材：先画角色形象和场景背景(9:16竖屏)，再合成导购员语音和背景音乐，最后拼成25秒的竖屏带货视频；也可以只生成其中某一类素材。
howto.when: 当用户提出要制作小省导购员数字人带货视频，或要求生成其中的角色形象、场景背景、语音等素材时，进入本技能。

say.text: 帮我生成小省导购员的带货视频，9:16竖屏
say.note: Claude会分步产出25秒的竖屏完整视频

say.text: 只生成小省导购员的角色参考图
say.note: 仅执行角色形象生成，不合成语音和视频

say.text: 用这段文案合成导购员语音和背景音乐

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude makes multimedia assets for a Xiaosheng shopping-guide promo video: draws character & scene (9:16 vertical), synthesizes voice & music, assembles a 25s vertical video. Can also output a single asset type.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create a Xiaosheng shopping-guide promo video, or requests one of its assets such as the character image, scene background, or voice-over.

say_en.text: Create a 9:16 vertical promo video for the Xiaosheng shopping guide.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a 25s full video in stages.

say_en.text: Only generate the character reference image for the Xiaosheng shopping guide.
say_en.note: Runs only the character-image generation step.

say_en.text: Use this sales script to synthesize voice-over and background music.
